metadata.title: Tollvakt – find the right commodity code
metadata.description: Describe a product in Norwegian or English and get the most likely Norwegian commodity codes (varenummer), with reasons, how sure the suggestion is and what to check, from Tolletaten's open data.

hero.title: Find the right commodity code before the goods reach the border
hero.lead: Describe the product in your own words. Tollvakt searches the Norwegian customs tariff, suggests the most likely commodity codes and explains why, so you know what to check before you declare.

example.lowReason: Only if the wool is from Kashmir goats.

features.title: What Tollvakt does
features.lead: From a product description to commodity codes you can check, in a few seconds.

describe.title: Write as you speak
describe.text: "Bluetooth earbuds" or "kosebamse": no need to know the tariff's own words.

reasons.title: Reasons you can check

questions.title: What decides the code

search.title: Search the tariff

describe.title: Describe the product

about.title: About Tollvakt
about.lead: Tollvakt helps Norwegian businesses find the right commodity code for the goods they import and export.

why.title: Why it exists
why.text1: Every imported or exported item needs a commodity code. The duty, the VAT basis and the rules for the goods all depend on it, and a wrong code found in an audit means paying the difference afterwards.
why.text2: The tariff has more than 7,000 codes, written in its own language. Tollvakt lets you describe the product in everyday words and shows you which codes are most likely, and why.

how.title: How it finds the codes

rewrite.title: Rewriting.
rewrite.text: A language model rewrites your description into the tariff's wording, in Norwegian and English.

search.title: Searching.
search.text: Full-text and semantic search find the candidate codes in the tariff.

choose.title: Choosing.
choose.text: The language model reads the candidates' paths in the tariff and picks up to three, with reasons. It can only pick codes from the tariff, never invent one.

how.limits: Tollvakt is tested on products with known codes, and it is still a help, not a decision. It does not yet read the tariff's section and chapter notes or Tolletaten's binding rulings. For certainty, apply for a binding classification ruling (BKU).

data.title: Where the data comes from
data.text: Everything is open data from Norwegian public agencies.
data.tolletaten: the customs tariff in Norwegian and English, duty rates, fees and exchange rates
data.ssb: import statistics, used to choose the products Tollvakt is tested on

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.account: Your account: name, email address and language. The password is stored only as a hash.
privacy.classifications: Your classifications: what you described and the answer you got, so you can see them again. You can delete them one by one, or all of them with your account.
privacy.usage: How many classifications you have made each day, for the daily limit. For visitors without an account, only a coded form of the address is kept, never the address itself.
privacy.notStored: Your descriptions are sent to the language model to be classified. Do not write trade secrets or personal information in them.
